(2) PDF download endpoint returns valid PDF with proper Content-Type and Content-Disposition headers when enabled, 403 when disabled. code_review_notes.auto_link_relations: Function at line 746-759 correctly identifies relation fields pointing to source panel and auto-populates with source_record_id (ObjectId). This ensures relation fields store ObjectIds instead of text values.
code_review_notes._normalize_key: Function at line 761-767 converts camelCase to snake_case by inserting underscores before uppercase letters, then lowercases and removes all underscores/spaces. This enables fuzzy matching between invoiceNumber and invoice_number.
code_review_notes.build_mapped_data: Function at line 769-822 implements three modes: manual_only (explicit mappings only), smart_sync (explicit + normalized matching), full_copy (copy all matching fields). Normalized matching uses _normalize_key for both source and target keys.
code_review_notes.PDF_generation: Uses reportlab library with proper styling (header, field labels, values, footer). Returns StreamingResponse with application/pdf content-type and attachment disposition.
